article.headline: Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt scores 14 as Alcorn State rolls past Mississippi Valley State 86-39
article.description: — Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt had 14 points and Alcorn State cruised to an 86-39 victory over Mississippi Valley State on Monday night.
article.linkText: Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt scores 14 as Alcorn State rolls past Mississippi Valley State 86-39

categories.description: Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils @ Alcorn State Braves

event.description: Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils @ Alcorn State Braves

keywords: Mississippi Valley State Delta Devils @ Alcorn State Braves
article.story: LORMAN, Miss. -- — Jalyke Gaines-Wyatt had 14 points and Alcorn State cruised to an 86-39 victory over Mississippi Valley State on Monday night. Gaines-Wyatt finished 5 of 7 from the field for the Braves (7-17, 7-4 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Mike Pajeaud had 13 points and seven rebounds. Daniel Braster shot 6 of 9 from the floor and scored 13. The Delta Devils (3-21, 1-10) were led by Donovan Sanders with 10 points. Jair Horton added nine points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
